metadata.title: CNCF Source Repository — Shared Base Component Definition

components.title: CNCF Source Repository
components.description: Shared software component representing any CNCF source repository.
components.purpose: Define compliance rules for CNCF source repositories.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Early Vulnerability Scanning: Vulnerability and configuration scanning must be integrated at the pull-request or CI stage.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Business-Critical Code Testing: Tests must exist for business-critical code paths.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Infrastructure Code Testing: Tests must exist for business-critical infrastructure.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Local Test Execution: Test suites must be runnable locally without external dependencies.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Two Non-Author Reviewers Approval: At least two non-author reviewers must approve before merging.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Clean Pipeline-as-Code: Code must be clean and well commented.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Full Infrastructure Tests: Full infrastructure tests must be present.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Regression Testing: Regression tests must be present.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Emerging Threat Test Updates: Test suites must be updated against new and emerging threats.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Threat Model Driven Testing Priorities: Threat model results must be used to determine test development priorities.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Secure Configuration Default State: Secure configuration must be the default state of the system.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: IDE and CI Vulnerability Scanning: Vulnerability and configuration scanning must be integrated in both IDE and CI pipeline.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Single Non-Author Reviewer Approval: At least one non-author reviewer must approve before merging.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Static Application Security Testing (SAST): Static application security testing (SAST) must be performed.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Manifest and Workflow Scanning: Application, workflow, and deployment manifests must be scanned and validated in the CI pipeline.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build Environment and Dependency Declaration: Build environments and dependencies must be validated before use.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Reproducible Builds Dependency Lock: Build artifacts must be reproducible; a dependency lock file must be present.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: External Requirements Hash Pinning: External requirements must be locked and verified with hash pinning.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Non-Determinism Elimination via Lock File: Sources of non-determinism must be eliminated; a lock file must be present.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build Environment Recording: The build environment must be recorded.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Automated Build Environment Creation: Creation of the build environment must be automated.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Pipeline-as-Code Automation: Build and CI/CD steps must be automated through pipeline-as-code.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Standardized Single Pipeline Entry Point: Pipelines must be standardized across projects using a single entry point.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Secured Pipeline Output Storage: Pipeline output must be written to a separate secured storage location.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Branch Protected Pipeline Modification: Pipeline modification must only be allowed through pipeline-as-code with branch protection.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Repository User Roles Definition: User roles must be defined for the repository.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Root-of-Trust Establishment Procedure: A root-of-trust establishment procedure must be documented.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Third-Party Artifact Declaration & Verification: Third-party artifacts and open source libraries must be declared and verified.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Supplier SBOM Requirement: An SBOM must be required from third-party suppliers.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Open Source Component Dependency Tracking: Dependencies between open source components must be tracked.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Trusted Package Managers and Repositories: Only trusted package managers and repositories must be used.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Immutable Code SBOM Generation: An immutable SBOM of the code must be generated.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Known Vulnerability Scanning: Software must be scanned for known vulnerabilities.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: License Compliance Scanning: Software must be scanned for license compliance.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Software Composition Analysis (SCA): Software composition analysis must be run on ingested software.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Cryptographic Commit and Tag Signing: All commits and tags must carry a valid GPG or SSH cryptographic signature, with exemption for automated release bot commits.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Default Branch Full Attestation and Verification: Full attestation and verification must be enforced for the default branch.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: No Unencrypted Secrets in Repository: No unencrypted secrets must be committed to the repository.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Explicit Repository Write Access Definition: Individuals or teams with write access must be explicitly defined.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Automated Pipeline Security Scanning: Software security scanning and testing must be automated in the pipeline.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Documented Contribution Policies: Contribution policies must be established and documented.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Functional Role Alignment: Roles must be defined and aligned to functional responsibilities.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Four-Eyes Principle Branch Protection: An independent four-eyes principle must be enforced via branch protection.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Default Branch Protection Rules Enabled: Branch protection rules must be enabled on the default branch.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: MFA Enforced for Repository Access: MFA must be enforced for accessing source code repositories.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: SSH Key Developer Access: SSH keys must be used to provide developer access to source code repositories.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Documented Key Rotation Policy: A key rotation policy must be documented.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Ephemeral Credentials for Automated Access: Short-lived or ephemeral credentials must be used for machine and service access.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Documented Code and Infrastructure Threat Model: A threat model for code and infrastructure must be documented.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Supply Chain Security Best Practices: Supply chain security best practices must be adhered to (SBOM, lock file, SCA).

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restricted Repository and Branch Access: Access to repository and branches must be restricted via branch protection and CODEOWNERS.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Prohibition of Unencrypted Stored Credentials: Unencrypted credentials or secrets must never be stored in the repository.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Strong Identity Enforcement with Signed Commits: Strong identity must be enforced with GPG-signed commits, with exemption for automated release bot commits.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Linear History and Force-Push Disallowed: Linear history must be enforced; force-push must be disallowed.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enforced Branching and Code Review Policy: Branching policy must be enforced with main branch protection and code review.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Git and GitOps Tool Vulnerability Monitoring: Git and GitOps tools must be monitored for vulnerabilities and kept up to date.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Regular SSH Key and PAT Rotation: SSH keys and Personal Access Tokens must be rotated regularly.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Dedicated Technical Accounts for Automation: Dedicated non-user technical accounts must be used for automated access.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Limited Permission Escalation Authority: Users who can escalate permissions must be limited to a pre-approved set.
